about: Hand-curated venue research for Scala Days, keyed by the code the pretalx adapter gives each building. Every figure is {value, source}; coordinates carry the basis they rest on.

kulturbrauerei.name: Kulturbrauerei
kulturbrauerei.notes: A former brewery, now an event complex in Prenzlauer Berg. Scala Days takes place mainly in its connected Palais, Maschinenhaus and Kesselhaus (scaladays.org); the labs are in its Frannz Salon.
